summary: Realty Income Corp filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a purchase agreement to issue and sell EUR 600 million aggregate principal amount of 3.625% Notes due 2032. The offering is a standard investment-grade debt issuance for a REIT, not a special situation transaction. It will close July 7, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No change of control, activist event, or acquisition/divestiture is involved. The proceeds will likely be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets activity.
